description: This file is a C++ source code implementing multithreading and memory probing functionalities within the 'unraveller' module. It defines classes for thread management, memory probing, random data generation, and command-line options, along with a main function that orchestrates thread execution based on user input.

classes.name: IThreader
classes.description: Interface for thread management, supporting different threading implementations and a factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: Thread-safe class for outputting to std::ostream, ensuring synchronized access.

classes.name: MemProber
classes.description: Utility class for probing and dumping process memory statistics.

classes.name: Randomizer
classes.description: Class for generating random numbers with reseeding capabilities.

classes.name: ConsoleOptions
classes.description: Command-line options parser for configuring thread count, stack size, and thread type.

classes.name: CommonThreader
classes.description: Base class implementing common thread control logic for different threading models.

classes.name: PThreader
classes.description: Implementation of IThreader using POSIX pthreads.

classes.name: StdThreader
classes.description: Implementation of IThreader using C++ std::thread.

classes.name: WorkLoad
classes.description: Callback class that performs memory allocation and simulated workload for threads.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Factory method to create threader instances based on specified type.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Performs workload, including memory allocation and synchronization.

methods.name: Arm
methods.description: Prepares the workload to start execution.
